name.en: Fio Puro Black Structured Leather Tote with Twin Top Handles and a Firm Rectangular Body

description.en: A black leather tote with a structured rectangular body and twin top handles. It stands open on a desk without collapsing.
description.pt-BR: Tote preta de couro, corpo retangular estruturado e duas alças. Fica aberta sobre a mesa sem desabar.
